items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story involving a 'little Jew fellow' and 'She' (likely his wife/partner), but 'Jes'' appears only as a quoted word ('Jes'...pick it up') within that narrative, not as a named individual with whom the interviewee has a personal relationship.

ctx.x: So the little Jew fellow was so happy. When we walked in the store, there was two...three other people in there, and so they just kind of overlooked us. We didn't look too rich. So, the little Jew fellow come over and said, "Can I help you-all?"

So we started buyin' all...orderin' up all this stuff. Eve'- body started lookin'...showin'..."How you like this? How you like this? How you like that?" She picked out all the stuff. She picked it all out. Said, "You want all that stuff you picked out?" She say, "You written it down, didn't you?" Say, "Yeah." Say, "Jes'...pick it up." Say, "This is on credit?" He didn't have no idea she gonna pay cash.
She say, "No, it's cash." He liked to fell off his stool. So I tol' her, I say, "We ain't payin' cash for that stuff. We buyin' it on credit like ever'body else do."
